provenance: Assistant tạo từ định nghĩa lớp, cố định ngày 2026-10-10; không lấy từ dòng dữ liệu hoặc lỗi validation. Mô tả dùng cho nhánh ảnh, không phải đầu ra GPT-3 gốc của paper.

not_humanitarian: an everyday scene unrelated to disaster impacts or relief
a personal portrait or entertainment image without visible crisis information
an advertisement unrelated to humanitarian assistance
other_relevant_information: a map showing a storm path or an affected geographical area
a weather chart or an official disaster warning graphic
a wide view of a hazard without a specific damaged object or victim
rescue_volunteering_or_donation_effort: rescue workers helping people reach safety
volunteers distributing food, water, or emergency supplies
a donation appeal or an organized relief collection
infrastructure_and_utility_damage: collapsed buildings or broken walls surrounded by rubble
damaged roads, bridges, or power lines
houses or public facilities visibly damaged by flooding or fire
affected_individuals: displaced families carrying belongings away from their homes
survivors staying in a temporary shelter
people stranded or waiting for assistance in a disaster area
vehicle_damage: cars or buses submerged in floodwater
overturned vehicles or wrecked boats after a disaster
injured_or_dead_people: injured people receiving emergency medical treatment
covered bodies or visibly deceased victims in a disaster setting
missing_or_found_people: a missing person notice with a portrait and contact information
a list of people reported missing or located
a public announcement that a previously missing person has been found
